arxiv-2108-06980.title: Task-Sensitive Concept Drift Detector with Constraint Embedding
arxiv-2108-06980.creator: Andrea Castellani, Sebastian Schmitt, Barbara Hammer
arxiv-2108-06980.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrea Castellani, Sebastian Schmitt, Barbara Hammer. Detecting drifts in data is essential for machine learning applications, as changes in the statistics of processed data typically has a profound influence on the performance of trained models. Most of the available drift detection methods are either supervised and require access to the true labels during inference time, or they are completely unsupervised and aim for changes in distributions without taking label information into account.

arxiv-2203-13003.title: Giant electromagnetic proximity effect in superconductor/ferromagnet superlattices
arxiv-2203-13003.creator: A. V. Putilov, S. V. Mironov, A. S. Mel’nikov, A. I. Buzdin
arxiv-2203-13003.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. V. Putilov, S. V. Mironov, A. S. Mel’nikov, A. I. Buzdin. We show that in superlattices with alternating superconducting (S) and ferromagnetic (F) layers the spontaneous magnetic field induced in the superconducting layers due to the electromagnetic proximity effect becomes dramatically enhanced compared to the previously studied S/F bilayers. The effect reveals itself for the in-plane orientation of the magnetic moments both for ferromagnetic and anti-ferromagnetic ordering of the moments in the F layers.

arxiv-2312-02613.title: A Unified Simulation Framework for Visual and Behavioral Fidelity in Crowd Analysis
arxiv-2312-02613.creator: Niccoló Bisagno, Nicola Garau, Antonio Luigi Stefani, Nicola Conci
arxiv-2312-02613.description: Abstract Simulation is a powerful tool to easily generate annotated data, and a highly desirable feature, especially in those domains where learning models need large training datasets. Machine learning and deep learning solutions, have proven to be extremely data-hungry and sometimes, the available real-world data are not sufficient to effectively model the given task.

arxiv-2409-17296.description: Abstract We present photometric and spectroscopic observations of SN 2020xga and SN 2022xgc, two hydrogen-poor superluminous supernovae (SLSNe-I) at z = 0.4296 z=0.4296 and z = 0.3103 z=0.3103 respectively, that show an additional set of broad Mg II absorption lines, blueshifted by a few thousands km s -1 with respect to the host galaxy absorption system.

arxiv-2504-13810.title: Disentangling the Effects of Temperature, Clouds, and Gravity on K I doublet in L dwarfs Doublet_Quantifier ( A. Baldelli & K. Cruz 2024 ) , Quantifying_Sonora_KI_Doublet https://github.com/BDNYC/quantifying_sonora_KI_doublet
arxiv-2504-13810.creator: Alexandra J. Baldelli, Genaro Suárez, Kelle L. Cruz, Jacqueline K. Faherty, Austin Rothermich
arxiv-2504-13810.description: Abstract We investigate the effects of surface gravity, effective temperature, and cloudiness on the potassium doublet (K I) at 1.17 μm in brown dwarf spectra. Using pseudo-Voigt profiles to fit the K I doublet in Sonora Diamondback atmospheric model spectra, we find that gravity and cloudiness affect the spectra differently in mid to late-L dwarfs.

pmc-10667713.creator: Lisa-Lou Gracia, Philip Henkel, Olaf Fuhr, Claudia Bizzarri
pmc-10667713.description: Developing efficient catalysts for reducing carbon dioxide, a highly stable combustion waste product, is a relevant task to lower the atmospheric concentration of this greenhouse gas by upcycling. Selectivity towards CO2-reduction products is highly desirable, although it can be challenging to achieve since the metal-hydrides formation is sometimes favored and leads to H2 evolution.

pmc-10740902.title: Germ Line/Multipotency Genes Show Differential Expression during Embryonic Development of the Annelid Enchytraeus coronatus
pmc-10740902.creator: Roman P Kostyuchenko, Daria D Nikanorova, Artem V Amosov, Malgorzata Kloc
pmc-10740902.description: Simple SummaryGermline cells are a key cell type in virtually all multicellular animals. They are a source of gametes and are necessary for sexual reproduction. Thus, the establishment and maintenance of the germ line is critical in the life of most animals. Specification of primordial germ cells occurs by involvement of conserved sets of genes.

pmc-12452348.title: Enhanced Bacterial Cellulose Production Using Hempseed Meal: Optimal Conditions and Properties
pmc-12452348.creator: Sawichaya Orpool, Suthaphat Kamthai, Thanyaporn Siriwoharn, Patompong Khaw-on, Aree Deenu, Srisuwan Naruenartwongsakul
pmc-12452348.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hemp (Cannabis sativa L.) seed is progressively emerging as an innovative and sustainable source of plant oil. Defatted hempseed meal is rich in protein and carbohydrates, which bacteria can convert into cellulose using glucose and fructose. The optimal conditions for bacterial cellulose (BC) production from hempseed meal were evaluated by investigating total solid concentrations ranging from 8 to 16 °Brix using Komagataeibacter nataicola under controlled conditions.

pmc-12731139.creator: Yang Gu, Zelin Wang, Zhong Huang, Yuchuang Tong, Pengyuan Zhao, Heming Jia
pmc-12731139.description: Snake-like robots, characterized by their high flexibility and multi-joint structure, exhibit exceptional adaptability to complex terrains such as snowfields, jungles, deserts, and underwater environments. Their ability to navigate narrow spaces and circumvent obstacles makes them ideal for operations in confined or rugged environments.

pmc-12853970.title: Spinal cord injury in the context of major motor vehicle collision trauma: a retrospective ecological analysis of global estimates across income groups
pmc-12853970.creator: Tim Nutbeam, Jessica Caterson, Colleen J. Saunders, Hendry R. Sawe, Sabariah Faizah Jamaluddin, Ian Roberts, Jason E. Smith, Paulus Ambunda, Willem Stassen
pmc-12853970.description: IntroductionRoad traffic injuries (RTIs) are a leading cause of death globally, especially in low- (LICs) and middle-income countries (LMICs). Despite this burden, post-crash care remains underdeveloped. Many clinical principles of post-crash care focus on spinal cord injury (SCI), yet its incidence is poorly understood.

pmc-12979865.title: Spontaneous reduction of type I traumatic manubriosternal joint dislocation: A case report
pmc-12979865.creator: Jin-Uk Choi, Jung Hee Choi, Junepill Seok
pmc-12979865.description: We report the case of a 68-year-old male who sustained blunt chest trauma in a motor vehicle accident and presented with severe chest pain, dyspnea, pneumothorax, and multiple rib fractures. Imaging revealed a complete type I manubriosternal joint dislocation with an associated retrosternal hematoma.

pmc-13178423.title: Correlations of 18F-FDG PET/CT metabolic parameters and systemic immune-inﬂammation index with distant metastasis of small-size (T1) NSCLC
pmc-13178423.creator: Lihua Wang, Liu Liu, Maomei Ruan, Cheng Chang, Aimi Zhang, Wenhui Xie, Bin Zhang
pmc-13178423.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAlthough small-size (T1, solid nodule with maximum diameter <3 cm) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is generally associated with a favorable prognosis, a notable subset of patients present with distant metastasis, a paradox that conventional staging fails to address. Fluorine-18-fluorodeoxyglucose (18F-FDG) positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) metabolic parameters and the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) are linked to NSCLC progression, but their associations with distant metastasis in small-size NSCLC remain unclear.

pmc-13225172.title: Hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia syndrome in a Sudanese patient: a case report
pmc-13225172.creator: Mohamed Abdullatif Mukhtar, Ahmed Alnazear Abdalla Amine, Sahar Abdelatif Muctar, Muntasir Eltayeb Ibrahim, Hiba Salaheldin Mohamed
pmc-13225172.description: Hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia (HED) is a rare genodermatosis characterised by defects in the development of ectodermal tissues, primarily affecting hair, teeth, and sweat glands. It can be inherited in autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive, or X-linked patterns. Mutations in the EDA, EDAR, or EDARADD genes, which encode Ectodysplasin-A, the EDA receptor, and a death domain, respectively, are responsible for HED.
